packageRules.description: Non-breaking updates merge themselves through the merge queue.
devDependencies never reach a consumer, so majors are safe to automerge too.
Majors of anything a consumer resolves stay manual.

`ts-5.4`, `ts-5.5` and `ts-6.0` are npm aliases for those exact TypeScript releases. They exist so `test:type` proves the emitted types still compile on each compiler the matrix pins. Bumping them defeats the entire point of the matrix.
